The '''Emergency Life Support Unit''' was manufactured by [[MineSystems]]. It was a portable [[Life support/Legends|life support system]] that was designed for use in underground [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. In the even of a cave-in, the unit could provide enough [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] for ten people for a duration of thirty [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="FBS" />
